scope: Exact finite diagnostic model; not an empirical validation of the framework.

nonequilibrium_perturbation.conclusion: No single scalar state potential q can reproduce all three rate ratios after the perturbation.

coarse_graining.conclusion: K and the partition alone do not determine the macro A->B rate away from a declared source occupancy or lumpability condition.

energy_degeneracy_reparameterization.conclusion: Equilibrium weights identify the effective combination E-log2(mu), not E and mu separately.

nonclaims: This toy model is not experimental evidence.
The reconstruction of q from K is classical detailed-balance structure, not a new theorem.
The occupancy dependence of coarse-graining is classical and does not establish a new physical field pi.
No spacetime, gravity, quantum, or pregeometric interpretation is inferred.
